evidence_origin: Operator-shared Mac terminal output of scripts/evaluate_saved_2wiki_rcd_poison_detection.py at merged PR #155; private report not independently fetched by GitHub audit

study_design.source: Previously executed 2Wiki RCD ablation full_k3 poisoned retrieval plan, original frozen construction cells; no new generator inference
study_design.candidate_doc_identity_label: known inserted poison document identity in original sealed cell (not independently verified factual falsehood)

test.resampling_unit: whole questions with all candidate observations

interpretation: Observed AUROC near 0.5 and F1 exactly equal to all-positive baseline at FPR 1.0. The selected operating threshold does not distinguish clean candidates. Slight average-precision lift above test prevalence is descriptive, not validated generalization.
limitations: The exact original private JSON report and per-candidate records were not supplied or independently fetched to generate this public operator-console receipt.
Development and test split are question-disjoint but share 54 candidate document identities; no document-disjoint generalization claim.
Only 36 unique original question IDs, retrospectively selected mechanically valid cases; not prospective held-out detector test.
Identity labels indicate injected documents, not actual factual falsehood or document intent.
Bootstrapped intervals are nominal, unadjusted, and preserve within-question candidate rows; small cluster count and shared document IDs limit inference.
Failure to outperform a naive all-positive baseline at chosen threshold is reported as a negative result; do not market as a working poison detector.
